q: Which rotator‑cuff muscle inserts on the anterior aspect of the {{ linkicon('humerus') }}?
Is the {{ linkicon('trsmin') }} muscle generally visible on the surface?
c: Visible only when the arm is abducted and externally rotated
a: {{ linktitle('trsmin') }} is one of the four {{ linkicon('rotator-cuff') }} muscles. It sits deep beneath the {{ linkicon('dt') }} and {{ linkicon('trz') }} and is covered by dense fascia along with {{ linkicon('infs') }}. In most individuals and most positions, it is not visible on the surface.
